crop.notes: Full Sporting Notes column; two items mention Allen

ocr.notes: a few errors ('Soppen' for Koppen, 'rene cores fms' for twenty-seven games)

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat noted that Denver heavyweight Ed Smith and his brother Paddy had spent a few days with their old friend Tom Allen, and carried Allen's notice for free nightly concerts at 619 Market Street.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, January 1, 1893

facts.fact: Allen advertised his concert hall at 619 Market Street as "retired champion pugilist of the world," with a free concert every evening
Denver heavyweight Ed Smith and his brother Paddy spent a few days visiting their old friend Tom Allen in St. Louis

notes: Smith visit is the week before Jan 1, 1893; Allen later seconded Smith against Joe Goddard (article 888).
